items.title: Unit 3 · Story
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.storyText: I see an iguana. I want a hot dog. This is a bear. It is a gorilla. I want my bear! I want a gorilla!
items.why: In “Story 3”, you hear: It is a gorilla. The missing word is “gorilla”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
